r13.exp: 'He LIKED TO TALK TO THE PUBLIC and see them ENJOY THEMSELVES' — glavna motivacija bila je zabavljanje publike = D.

r14.exp: 'In a PARADE OF GIANTS as part of the CELEBRATIONS FOR THE CORONATION OF KING GEORGE V' = kraljevska proslava = C.

r15.exp: 'He was a HAPPY, WELL-ADJUSTED CHAP' = nije ga mučilo = A (It did not trouble him). 'Blessing' dolazi od Jim Cooka, ne izravno od Stanleya.

r16.exp: 'He had a good WORKING RELATIONSHIP with Don, who NEVER TOOK ADVANTAGE of him' = tretirao ga pošteno = C.

r17.exp: 'Its role in HELPING ME RECONNECT WITH FAMILY has been its GREATEST GIFT to me' = pronašao obitelj = A.

r18.exp: 'His DOCTOR'S CASE NOTES say he stood 7FT 9IN, which is NOW KNOWN to have been the case' = stvarna visina = B.

r19.exp: 'Personality fascinates and challenges us. (19)___. Meanwhile, our identity defined by psychologists.' → D: Psychologists and scientists have devoted themselves to understanding it for more than a century.

r20.exp: 'We are all made up of conflicting traits. (20)___. For example, careful in one area but spontaneous in another.' → F: They make us the individuals that we are, but also unpredictable.

r21.exp: 'Personality differences encoded in language. (21)___. This theory debated and refined.' → C: If we could sample language, we could build a complete lexicon of human personality traits.

r22.exp: 'Identified the big five traits. (22)___. If high in openness, you are likely to be adventurous.' → G: Each trait indicates or predicts the way you may behave in certain situations.

r23.exp: 'What did researchers hope to gain? (23)___. Personality only of interest if gives info about behaviour.' → B: Aside from the satisfaction of cracking the code, the aim was to predict human behaviour.

r24.exp: 'Carter argues people behave differently depending on context. (24)___. Instead of saying one type, it is more complex.' → H: It shows that we have several personalities, and the one that comes to the fore depends on the situation.

r25.exp: 'Walk ON average' — fiksna kolokacija: on average = prosječno.

r26.exp: 'For the past 30 years we HAVE BEEN told' — present perfect za period koji traje do danas (for the past 30 years).

r27.exp: 'Maximise the INTENSITY of the pleasure' — 'intensity' = intenzitet, jačina (o osjećajima/iskustvima).

r28.exp: 'So as NOT TO INTRUDE on their privacy' — fiksna konstrukcija: so as to + infinitive; negacija: so as not to.

r29.exp: 'Take place AT a distance' — fiksna kolokacija: at a distance = na razdaljini.

r30.exp: '(30)___ turns the city into a lonely place' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (uz zarez, odnosi se na cijelu prethodnu surečenicu).

r31.exp: 'Could have 1,800 contacts; HOWEVER, end up having no more than five' — 'however' za kontrast/suprotnost.

r32.exp: 'Would not be possible if the inhabitants WERE NOT LIVING by rules' — uvjetna rečenica 2. tipa (nerealni uvjet u sadašnjosti): if + past continuous.

r33.exp: 'Organization WHOSE purpose is to operate' — posvojni relativni prilog 'whose' (organization + its purpose = whose purpose).

r34.exp: 'Twenty countries TAKE part in its work' — fiksna kolokacija: take part in = sudjelovati u.

r35.exp: 'Refers TO the laboratory' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: refer to = odnositi se na.

r36.exp: 'Conducted AT CERN' — prijedlog 'at' za institucije/mjesta (conducted at a laboratory/organization).

r37.exp: 'It MAKES/RENDERS this data immediately available' — 'make available' ili 'render available' = staviti nešto dostupnim.

r38.exp: 'Seem to HAVE found' — perfektni infinitiv: seem to have + past participle (za prošlu radnju).

r39.exp: '50 years AGO' — 'ago' za prošlu radnju mjerenu od sadašnjosti.

r40.exp: 'Result IN an explanation' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: result in = rezultirati nečime.
